story.description:
User Story
As a registered Webook user,
I want to browse available auctions, view auction item details, place bids, and track the auction status,
So that I can participate in auctions and compete for items of interest.

module url = https://webook.com/en/page/auctions
Business Value
Provide users with a seamless auction experience that enables real-time bidding, improves engagement, and increases successful auction participation.
Acceptance Criteria
AC-01 – Auction Listing
User can navigate to the Auctions module.
Active auctions are displayed.
Each auction card displays the auction title, image, current highest bid, auction status, and end time.
AC-02 – Auction Details
User can open an auction item.
The detail page displays item information, description, images, bidding rules, current highest bid, minimum next bid, remaining auction time, and seller information (if applicable).
AC-03 – Place Bid
Authenticated users can place a bid greater than or equal to the minimum allowed bid.
The system validates the bid before submission.
Successful bids update the current highest bid.
AC-04 – Bid Validation
Bid amount below the minimum allowed bid is rejected.
Invalid bid values display appropriate validation messages.
Users who are not signed in are prompted to authenticate before bidding.
AC-05 – Auction Status
Auction status updates correctly when:
Auction is active.
Auction has ended.
Bidding is unavailable.
AC-06 – Error Handling
User-friendly error messages are displayed if bid submission fails.
System recovers gracefully from temporary failures.
AC-07 – Accessibility
Interactive controls are keyboard accessible.
Screen reader labels are available.
Focus order is logical.
Non-Functional Requirements
Auction pages load within acceptable performance limits.
Bid submission is processed reliably.
UI is responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Supported browsers include Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari.
